SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(n.id) AS novel_count, IFNULL(SUM(n.word_count), 0) AS total_words, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(n.word_count), 2), 0) AS avg_words, IFNULL(MAX(n.word_count), 0) AS max_words, IFNULL(MIN(n.word_count), 0) AS min_words, IFNULL(SUM(n.view_count), 0) AS total_views, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(n.view_count), 2), 0) AS avg_views,
SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_count, IFNULL(SUM(n.favorite_count), 0) AS total_favorites FROM category c LEFT JOIN novel n ON n.category_id = c.id AND n.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY novel_count DESC

SELECT author, COUNT(*) AS novel_count, SUM(view_count) AS total_views, SUM(favorite_count) AS total_favorites, SUM(chapter_count) AS total_chapters, ROUND(AVG(view_count), 0) AS avg_views FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0 AND author IS NOT NULL AND author <> '' GROUP BY author HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCount} ORDER BY total_views DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0) AS novel_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter) AS chapter_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0) AS user_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND role='ADMIN') AS admin_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite) AS favorite_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_history) AS history_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM download_task) AS task_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM download_task WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS task_completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM download_task WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','DOWNLOADING')) AS task_running, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(word_count), 0) FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0) AS word_total, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0) AS view_total, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(word_count),0),0) FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_word

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS day_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM novel WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY day_label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS day_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(done_chapter) AS chapters FROM download_task WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY day_label ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS read_novels, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS downloads, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) + COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) + COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS score FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN reading_history h ON h.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN download_task t ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'USER' GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
